architecture_summary: Jan is a local AI inference platform built as a Tauri desktop application with a React frontend. The architecture consists of: (1) Web UI layer using React 18 with i18n support, (2) Tauri native bridge providing IPC between frontend and backend, (3) Core TypeScript engine handling events, extensions, and model management, (4) Pluggable inference extensions supporting llama.cpp for general CPUs, MLX for Apple Silicon, RAG for document retrieval, and vector DB for embeddings, (5) Optional external API integration for cloud models (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). The app runs entirely locally with no mandatory cloud dependencies.
key_patterns: Tauri IPC pattern - frontend communicates with core via Tauri commands/events
Extension plugin pattern - inference backends loaded as plugins
Event-driven architecture - Core uses typed events for all state changes
Model Manager pattern - centralized model download, loading, and lifecycle
Tool Approval pattern - MCP tools require user consent before execution
OpenAI-compatible API - MLX server exposes OpenAI API for integration
i18n pattern - full internationalization with 14 language locales
Vitest testing - unit tests with coverage using Vitest framework
